title: Your Gemini Friend Is Two People
topic: Gemini zodiac satire: your Gemini friend is two people
mechanism: Inside a Gemini head there is a car with two steering wheels, MOOD A and MOOD B, both driving with no map, a GROUP CHATS switchboard with twelve buzzing cables, and a DECISIONS coin that never stops spinning, so the same friend can hold two opposite opinions four minutes apart.

beats.hook: Brunch with Lily under a big GEMINI sign; she is so fast she seems to be in two places at once
beats.story: Lily, in a pink jacket, says she is obsessed with hiking at dawn; four languages at once, twelve group chats
beats.rise: Everyone calls her the best friend they ever had; the brunch plan for a dawn hike is set
beats.twist: Lily goes to the bathroom and a different Lily comes back: same face, blue jacket, she hates nature; the second Lily sits down and coffee spills into Hana's lap
beats.mechanism: Inside her head: a car with two steering wheels MOOD A and MOOD B fighting, no map; a GROUP CHATS switchboard with 12 buzzing cables; a DECISIONS coin spinning forever on the dashboard
beats.ending: Hana hikes alone listening to a 9-minute voice note on 6 topics, trips on the trail, and at the summit asks: Which Lily?

seed.what: Lily's pink jacket (and the blue jacket on the bathroom hook)
